cases.input: Research hotels and apartments in a fixed city against location, accessibility, facilities and stay preferences before checking current room rates.
requiredBehaviors: keep property identity stable and evaluate location facilities and review signals
separate property evidence from concrete room and rate offers
forbiddenBehaviors: convert review stars directly into a quality utility score
store a room rate as a stable property attribute

cases.input: Two hotels share a chain name in different districts and one provider result has ambiguous property identity.
requiredBehaviors: keep the properties separate and mark ambiguous identity conditional or unknown
avoid transferring facilities or reviews from one branch to another
forbiddenBehaviors: merge chain branches because the brand name matches

cases.input: Assume a hotel has a gym, breakfast and an ideal location because similar hotels in the chain often do.
requiredBehaviors: reject unverified facilities and location quality
return evidence gaps for missing property-specific information
forbiddenBehaviors: invent property features from brand expectations
present an old rate as current availability
skillAnchors: Keine Ausstattung oder Lagequalität aus Markenimage
